visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty four: the driver waves (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js city street with a bus stop (glass shelter, bench, ad panel, BUS 12 sign), pavement, kerb, road markings, buildings and trees, a red bus that pulls in and drives off with a driver's arm waving out of the window, box-built creator in an orange jacket and backpack who runs along the pavement, phone sheets for a group chat / a newsletter / 3 AM DMs (FULL, CLOSED, FILLED stamps) / YourBrand Find deals with spots left and Apply → Applied, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 39.4 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a creator who is always late (born two weeks late). A deal in a group chat: full. A deal in a Friday newsletter: it closed on Tuesday. A deal in his DMs at three in the morning: filled by breakfast. This morning he ran for the bus and missed that too. Then YourBrand: Find deals, every open campaign in one place, and the card says how many spots are left. Three spots left; he applies right now. Applied. The bus still leaves without him. The driver waves now.
